description: A state top-up financial assistance initiative supplementing PM-KISAN payouts to ensure predictable cash flow for agricultural input purchases.
benefits: An additional annual cash transfer of ₹6,000 paid directly to the farmer's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in equal installments.
eligibility: Resident landholding farmers of Madhya Pradesh
Must be active and verified beneficiaries of the central PM-KISAN scheme
application_mode: Online via MP e-Uparjan / SAARA Portal

description: Protects farmers against market price crashes by paying the direct price difference whenever notified oilseeds and pulses sell below the Minimum Support Price (MSP) in state mandis.
benefits: Direct payment of the price gap between the MSP and market/model price directly into the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmers in MP cultivating notified Kharif/Rabi crops (soybean, pulses, oilseeds)
Must register produce on the e-Uparjan portal and sell through notified Krishi Upaj Mandis
documents: Mandi Sale Receipt & Weighment Slip (Toul Parchi)
application_mode: Online via MP e-Uparjan Portal / Mandi Samiti Office

description: Subsidizes standalone solar photovoltaic water pumping systems for agricultural irrigation in remote and off-grid farmlands.
benefits: Up to 90% capital subsidy on solar pumpsets (3 HP to 10 HP); farmers pay the remaining 10% share.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in MP with a verified water source (well, borewell, or stream)
Must not have an active grid-connected agricultural electricity connection
application_mode: Online via MP Solar Pump Portal

description: Provides financial grants to smallholders and farmer groups to purchase tractors, combine harvesters, rotavators, seed drills, and power tillers.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy (up to ₹1,50,000 – ₹2,00,000 depending on machine type and farmer category).
eligibility: Landholding farmers registered on the DBT Agriculture Portal of MP
Higher subsidy priority for SC/ST, women, and small/marginal farmers
application_mode: Online via MP DBT Farmer Portal (e-Krishi Yantra)

description: Promotes efficient water use by subsidizing drip and sprinkler systems across drought-prone and water-stressed districts.
benefits: 70% to 80% subsidy for small and marginal farmers; 55% to 60% for general landholding farmers.
eligibility: Farmers in MP possessing agricultural land with access to a functional water source

scheme_name: MP Baliraja Khet Talab Yojana (Farm Pond Scheme)
description: Provides financial assistance to build farm ponds (Khet Talab) on private land to catch monsoon rainwater and recharge groundwater.
benefits: Up to 50% financial grant (capped between ₹80,000 and ₹1,20,000 based on pond dimension and lining type).
eligibility: Individual farmers in MP owning at least 0.5 hectares of land
application_mode: Online via e-Anudan Portal / District Agriculture Office

description: Encourages cow-based chemical-free natural farming, incentivizing farmers to adopt Jeevamrut, Beejamrut, and indigenous seed cultivation.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹900 (total ₹10,800 annually) for indigenous cow upkeep and 75% subsidy on natural farming input kits.
eligibility: Farmers in MP practicing verified natural farming on minimum 0.25 acres
Must own at least one indigenous cow
application_mode: Online via MP Natural Farming Portal / Gram Sevak

description: Provides immediate financial relief and compensation to farming families in the event of accidental death or severe injury during agricultural work.
benefits: Ex-gratia grant of ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial disability.
eligibility: Farmers, farm laborers, and landless agricultural workers in MP aged 18 to 70 years
application_mode: Offline via Tehsil Office / District Collectorate

description: Subsidizes high-value fruit orchard establishment, polyhouse/shade net installation, and high-tech nursery development.
benefits: 50% capital grant on high-density fruit planting material, polyhouse setup, and drip system integration.
eligibility: Farmers in MP converting traditional crop fields into fruit or vegetable cultivation
application_mode: Online via MP FSTS Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: MP Acharya Vidyasagar Dairy Chhatra Yojana
description: Assists smallholders and unemployed rural youth in setting up modern dairy units with high-yielding milch cows or buffaloes.
benefits: Up to 25% subsidy for General category and 33.33% for SC/ST category (capped up to ₹1,50,000 to ₹2,00,000 per dairy unit).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and landless farmers in MP establishing a minimum unit of 5 to 10 milch cattle
application_mode: Offline via District Veterinary / Animal Husbandry Department
